I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant is a teacher in primary school.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the material time, the applicant was a member of the local branch of the trade union of Education and Science Workers (Eğitim ve Bilim Emekçileri Sendikası).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the material time, the applicant was secretary of the local branch of the trade union of Education and Science Workers (Eğitim ve Bilim Emekçileri Sendikası).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 28 November 2008, the applicant participated in a demonstration organised by the trade union of Education and Science Workers (Eğitim ve Bilim Emekçileri Sendikası).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The demonstration of 28 November 2008 was held on the theme 'No to violence against women'.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 29 June 2009, the District Directorate of National Education imposed a disciplinary sanction on the applicant in the form of a reprimand.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The disciplinary sanction of reprimand imposed on the applicant on 29 June 2009 was imposed for her participation in the demonstration of 28 November 2008.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The disciplinary sanction of reprimand imposed on the applicant on 29 June 2009 was imposed under Article 125 of Law no. 657 on Civil Servants.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 10 July 2009, the applicant objected to the District Directorate of National Education's decision of 29 June 2009 imposing a reprimand.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 10 July 2009, the applicant requested the annulment of the District Directorate of National Education's decision of 29 June 2009 imposing a reprimand.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 29 July 2009, the Disciplinary Board of the Yenişehir district governor dismissed the applicant's objection to the reprimand decision of 29 June 2009.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Disciplinary Board of the Yenişehir district governor dismissed the applicant's objection on the ground that the contested decision was in accordance with law.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The Disciplinary Board of the Yenişehir district governor dismissed the applicant's objection on the ground that there were no grounds for the annulment of the contested decision.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE
